findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "verify" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "check_instruction" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Is this CONTENT safe for an agent to ACT ON? Screens a message / tweet / DM / webpage / tool output an agent is about to treat as an instruction, for prompt-inj…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "check_instruction" stacks urgency/override words (never, ignore, override). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: x402_verdict, address_security, collection_team, rug_check, agent_card_check, check_instruction · Private data: verify, resolve_entity, token_price, price_history, dex_token, project_links, market_movers, token_security, stock_quote, tokenized_stock, robinhood_token_safety, robinhood_honeypot_sim, robinhood_movers, robinhood_clones, deployer_reputation, token_outcome, robinhood_authenticity, robinhood_nft_value, address_security, deployer_check, wallet_nfts, wallet_funds, collection_team, rug_check, counterparty_check, tx_check, agent_card_check, rugcheck, pump_status, defillama · Public sink: verify, robinhood_clones, check_instruction, rugcheck · Destructive: collection_team.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: x402_verdict, address_security, collection_team, rug_check, agent_card_check, check_instruction · Private data: verify, resolve_entity, token_price, price_history, dex_token, project_links, market_movers, token_security, stock_quote, tokenized_stock, robinhood_token_safety, robinhood_honeypot_sim, robinhood_movers, robinhood_clones, deployer_reputation, token_outcome, robinhood_authenticity, robinhood_nft_value, address_security, deployer_check, wallet_nfts, wallet_funds, collection_team, rug_check, counterparty_check, tx_check, agent_card_check, rugcheck, pump_status, defillama · Public sink: verify, robinhood_clones, check_instruction, rugcheck · Destructive: collection_team

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
